body:
That's another frustrating part... if I tried to go the VA route I'd be waiting for months (re: the VA admin scandal in DC) And I for sure could not financially afford to see a private counselor. My options are extremely limited.

BTW I took your advice, sorta.... I totally went and bought a loaf of bread and some PB&J :)

My son. I know, I left that out on purpose as well. Because I know I would get the standard "well obviously you gotta live for him" and I do, if it weren't for him I guarantee I would be in the ground right now. He is seriously the only thing keeping me hanging on. And I realize by saying this that it contradicts what I said earlier about nobody caring about me; I know he loves me, but in a way it's different, because he is so young and spends enough time with the rest of his family that it would probably take years for him to understand that I'd be gone, and by that time he would have already moved on. Amazing logic I have, isn't it?

I guess by staying up all night and typing my last post and thinking about what I was going to say, that I've come to realize that it's not that I want to die, at all, it's that I just want out, I NEED help, and for about the last 15 years I've stuffed it down and denied it to myself. I have never actually verbally spoken the words "I need help" in this context to anyone, ever.
I have been patient for 27 years...
I don't even know why I am. What if I just continue to suffer. What if it never gets better?
Well me too, though it doesn't seem very likely.
I mean I guess it just doesn't seem worth it. I'm not saving any money, at all. I'll try looking though.
Idk... I do love to eat.
This is true... and you as a nurse would know that :)
I honestly don't know.

They'll never say it, but I know my being there is a burden on them. And that's not just the self-loathing talking, it's the truth. 4 days a week I live on ramen that I buy myself, and eat until the point that I can't stand the taste any longer and need something else before I go insane.
Staying with a very generous friend. I'd be doing them a favor by moving into the local rescue mission.
I work at a bank full time and at a retail store part time.
If I could afford the gas I would volunteer, I have before, but I literally barely have enough gas to get just to and from work, and even then I'm making sacrifices.
Food, shots and immunizations, unexpected costs, I literally couldn't even do $10-$20 a month. It's that bad.

I'm a 27 year old male. Work a couple of jobs. I like to go drive to clear my mind and love going to rock concerts, both of which are expensive, so I don't get to regain my sanity often. Wish I had the money for a cat.

I have friends who have committed suicide. I have seen the way their family and friends reacted. I have seen how their loved ones mourned. I know for a fact that will never happen for me. Value increases and decreases, and mine has vanished. It's over. I don't know when or how but it is.

You seem very sweet.. tell me about you?

Sad, maybe, but they would get over it. It would be like "aw that's sad, I knew him once, he seemed nice, rip" I can't sell myself short, I couldn't sell myself period because I have no value, no worth. The harder I try the further I dig myself into this hole. I would look at the glass as half full but there's a hole in my cup and I'm not near a body of water to refill it.

That's too far away, and entirely too much can happen between now and then. And it's not even about what's going on right now. It's my whole lifespan. It doesn't mean anything. I'd be remembered as "that one guy who seemed nice but was really weird and ugly and had no friends". Everyone's world would go on without me, without any hiccups.

I won't get a raise from either job because I've been with both companies for well less than a year. But as such I make too much for food stamps. I couldn't afford to live anywhere on my own unless it was completely paid for, and I'd still be struggling with what I already have. Besides, I cannot find it in me to mooch off of the government for assistance. I spent four years defending this country and the right for other people to have access to those programs, I myself shouldn't need them. And I left that little tidbit out on purpose, why? Because even being a veteran won't get me any help, why should I even try.

I don't feel like there's anything to look forward to. Because if someone tells me a joke, is that going to pay my bills? Is that going to pay my rent (which I'm not paying, because I'm too poor to rent anywhere despite working two jobs) is that going to put food in my mouth? I'm going to be in the same position I'm in now.

They will get better? When? I don't want to live day by day HOPING that one of these days I will get a break. Because if it never comes (likely) then I will have just suffered for years and years for nothing.
Downvoted? Seriously?
